item.message: `[features].memory_tool` is deprecated. Use `[features].memories` instead. (Enable it with `--enable memories` or `[features].memories` in config.toml. See https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-basic#feature-flags for details.)

item.text: 65 — Conditional on superintelligent AI being built within 20 years, I think governments are more likely than not to be unable to reliably control its actions, though technical safeguards and international coordination could change that.
